import sqlite3, statistics as st
c = sqlite3.connect("file:wfscan.db?mode=ro", uri=True)
rid = c.execute("SELECT max(run_id) FROM runs").fetchone()[0]
rs = c.execute("SELECT sym,tf,price_ho,grid_ho_mean,ho_net,oos_sum,grid_oos_mean FROM jobs WHERE run_id=? AND oos_sum IS NOT NULL AND price_ho IS NOT NULL", (rid,)).fetchall()
print("n", len(rs))
def corr(a, b):
    ma, mb = st.mean(a), st.mean(b); sa = sum((x-ma)**2 for x in a)**.5; sb = sum((y-mb)**2 for y in b)**.5
    return sum((x-ma)*(y-mb) for x, y in zip(a, b))/(sa*sb)
print("corr(price_ho, grid_ho_mean) = %.2f" % corr([r[2] for r in rs], [r[3] for r in rs]))
print("corr(price_ho, ho_net) = %.2f" % corr([r[2] for r in rs], [r[4] for r in rs]))
up = [r for r in rs if r[2] > 0]; dn = [r for r in rs if r[2] <= 0]
print("price up in holdout: n %d, median grid_ho_mean %.1f, median ho_net %.1f, share ho_net>0 %.0f%%" % (len(up), st.median([r[3] for r in up]), st.median([r[4] for r in up]), 100*sum(1 for r in up if r[4] > 0)/len(up)))
print("price down in holdout: n %d, median grid_ho_mean %.1f, median ho_net %.1f, share ho_net>0 %.0f%%" % (len(dn), st.median([r[3] for r in dn]), st.median([r[4] for r in dn]), 100*sum(1 for r in dn if r[4] > 0)/len(dn)))
